name: Kasugai Sakura
source:
Main heroine and the little sister of the [url=/c1531]protagonist[/url]. She carries around a cellphone at all time but likes to read books. A bit bossy and speaks sharp penetrating words at times, she really just can’t become honest when it comes to her feelings for Yuma. Known as “imouto-sama” amongst the residents.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/07/21/sukima-zakura-to-uso-no-machi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
